messages.author: 790e074c50910616
messages.subject: Error in running calculateDiffMeth
parts:
Hi Altuna,

I am trying to remove some chromosomes from my differential methylation analysis which are chrX and chrY.

Used this code:
myobj4 = methRead(location = file.list, sample.id = list("A3","A4","A6", "A7", "A8", "A22", "A247", "P018"), 
                  assembly = "hg19", dbtype = "tabix", pipeline = "bismarkCytosineReport",
                  header = FALSE, skip = 0, sep = "\t", resolution = "base", 
                  treatment = c(1,1,1,1,1,0,0,0), dbdir = "ALS_methyl_call", mincov = 10, )

meth.min_4=unite(myobj4,min.per.group = 3L)

test_methmin4 <- getMembers(meth.min_4)

meth.min_4_removedXY <- test_methmin4[which(test_methmin4$chr != "chrX" & test_methmin4$chr != "chrY"),]

mydiff_5_removedXY = calculateDiffMeth(meth.min_4_removedXY)
Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 
  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘calculateDiffMeth’ for signature ‘"data.frame"’


Could you please help how can I calculateDiffMeth, again?

Much appreciate it!

Thank you,
Shruti

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Error in running calculateDiffMeth
parts:
As the error indicates you are trying to run the function on the wrong kind of object 

Best
Altuna
